cps.name: Cyclone Phase Space classification
cps.description: Per-cyclone structural category in the Hart (2003) Cyclone Phase Space, after a 36 h persistence gate and the subtropical/tropical identification guards. Distinct from the per-timestep cps_class and cps_state columns of the consolidated base.

kind_meaning.identified: passed the 36 h persistence gate and the identification guards
kind_meaning.characteristic: dominant structure that never lasted 36 h; a description, not an identification
kind_meaning.no_data: no CPS series for this cyclone

EC_like.label: extratropical characteristics, not sustained for 36 h

undetermined.label: no structure held for the persistence gate, none dominant

SC_like.label: hybrid characteristics, not sustained for 36 h

no_cps_data.label: no CPS series computed for this cyclone

TC_like.label: warm-core characteristics, not sustained for 36 h
